review_candidates.description: About The Company Movate is a leading global technology solutions provider dedicated to transforming business operations through innovative digital services. Our commitment to innovation, agility, and customer-centricity positions us as a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to navigate the complexities of modern digital landscapes. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior L3 Network Operations Engineer specializing in Routing & Switching, SD-WAN, and Zscaler to join our dynamic team at Movate. In this pivotal role, you will serve as an escalation point within our NOC (Network Operations Center), handling complex incidents related to enterprise network infrastructure, cloud security, and SD-WAN solutions. Reporting directly to the NOC Lead L3 Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to troubleshoot and resolve critical issues, support the operational stability of client networks, and mentor junior engineers. This role is primarily remote, supporting our EMEA clients during standard business hours, with occasional participation in after-hours activities for major incidents or planned maintenance. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess over 10 years of experience in network operations, with a strong background in enterprise routing and switching, SD-WAN technologies, and Zscaler cloud security solutions. Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, or equivalent are highly desirable. Proven expertise in troubleshooting complex network issues, handling high-severity incidents, and guiding teams through technical investigations is essential. Familiarity with ITIL processes, ITSM tools like ServiceNow, and automation scripting (Python, PowerShell) will be advantageous. Candidates should demonstrate excellent communication skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, client-focused environment. Responsibilities Act as the primary escalation point for complex network, SD-WAN, and Zscaler incidents, ensuring timely resolution and minimal service disruption. Diagnose and analyze issues originating from endpoints, network infrastructure, identity management, firewalls, ISP, SD-WAN, and Zscaler components. Support and mentor L2 engineers during advanced troubleshooting, fostering knowledge sharing and skill development. Lead technical investigations during major incidents, particularly P1 and P2 cases, coordinating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Provide expert L3 support for enterprise network infrastructure, including routing, switching, SD-WAN, and Zscaler services such as ZIA and ZPA. Manage incident lifecycle, including service requests and changes, adhering to defined SLAs and operational standards. Monitor network performance, availability, and overall service health, proactively identifying potential issues. Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and service providers to facilitate incident resolution and ensure service continuity. Participate in change validation, maintenance activities, and post-change troubleshooting to ensure seamless operations. Conduct root cause analysis for recurring and high-impact incidents, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. Create and maintain comprehensive troubleshooting guides, operational runbooks, and knowledge base articles to support ongoing operations. Benefits At Movate, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your professional growth and personal well-being. You will have access to competitive salary packages, health insurance coverage, and paid time off. We also provide opportunities for continuous learning through training programs, certifications, and skill development initiatives. Our flexible work arrangements support work-life balance, and you will be part of a collaborative, innovative environment that encourages knowledge sharing and career advancement. Additionally, employees benefit from exposure to cutting-edge technologies and complex network environments, fostering expertise and leadership in the field. Equal Opportunity Movate is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds drive innovation and excellence, and we strive to provide a supportive environment where all employees can thrive and succeed.

Through innovative scientific work, ISAS aims to enhance prevention, early diagnosis, and treatment strategies for major health conditions such as cardiovascular diseases and cancer. The institute’s core mission is to advance personalized therapy by integrating expertise across multiple disciplines including biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. As a member of the Leibniz Association, ISAS benefits from public funding provided by the Federal Republic of Germany and its states, supporting its commitment to scientific excellence and societal impact. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated IT Systems Engineer (m/f/d) to join our IT Services team at ISAS. Your primary focus will be on maintaining a GPU-based AI environment, ensuring seamless operation of workload management systems, and providing reliable support for various software applications used across the institute. You will collaborate closely with research teams and IT colleagues to plan, deploy, and enhance our technological capabilities, contributing significantly to the institute’s scientific endeavors. The position offers an exciting opportunity to work within a dynamic research environment that values innovation, security, and continuous improvement. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a university degree (bachelor’s, master’s, or equivalent) in computer science, systems engineering, or a related field, along with several years of professional experience in IT infrastructure, networking, or system administration. Responsibilities Install, administer, and further develop workload management systems tailored for a GPU-based AI environment, ensuring optimal performance and resource utilization. review_candidates.title: Cloud Operational Engineer (L3)
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Cloud Operational Engineer (L3) to serve as the senior technical authority and final escalation point for a multi-client cloud environment. This is a hands-on operations role focused on complex incidents, identity and access, Microsoft cloud platforms, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, automation, and maintaining operational standards. Key Responsibilities Resolve complex cloud, identity, endpoint, and platform incidents across client environments. Manage Entra ID, Azure RBAC/PIM, app registrations, service principals, Conditional Access, and MFA . Administer Microsoft 365 , including Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams. Support Intune, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 Cloud PC , and endpoint environments. Troubleshoot DNS, SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, Azure VMs, and cloud platforms. Lead major incident response and perform root cause analysis for recurring issues. Create and maintain technical runbooks, operational standards, and troubleshooting documentation. Develop PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation to reduce repetitive operational work. Monitor and support multiple client tenants while maintaining strict tenant isolation and security standards. Work within ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and knowledge management processes. Requirements 6–10+ years of experience in cloud, identity, workplace, or related engineering, including L3/SME-level experience. Proven experience as a final escalation point in a production environment. Strong expertise in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Intune, and endpoint management . Hands-on experience with Azure RBAC, PIM, VMs, storage, Key Vault, and Log Analytics. Strong knowledge of SAML, SCIM, SSO, identity security, and Zero Trust principles. Production-level PowerShell automation experience, including Microsoft Graph PowerShell. Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. Hands-on ServiceNow experience is required. Experience with Confluence or a similar knowledge-management platform. Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Zabbix or Azure Monitor . MSP / managed services / multi-tenant experience is required. Strong client-facing communication and incident-management skills. Preferred Certifications Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-102) Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), Security Operations Analyst (SC-200), or ITIL 4 Foundation are advantageous.

review_candidates.title: IT Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: We’re looking for an IT Support Engineer to join our IT team on a full-time basis and provide hands-on technical support across MRC and our associated businesses. This is a practical, varied role supporting workstations, devices, Microsoft 365, networks, POS and workplace technology across our offices, venues and racecourses. You’ll troubleshoot issues, manage devices and user accounts, support new technology and help keep our teams connected and productive. With MRC operating across multiple sites and a busy calendar of race meetings and events, there’s plenty of variety, from resolving a day-to-day technology issue to providing on-site support when it matters most. About Us Melbourne Racing Club (MRC) is an iconic sporting and entertainment organisation with a proud 150-year legacy. While we’re renowned for hosting elite horse racing at Caulfield, Sportsbet Sandown and Mornington Racecourses, we’re also so much more. From vibrant events and functions to our 17 Pegasus Leisure Group (PLG) hospitality venues across Victoria and community initiatives through the MRC Foundation, we’re dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences for our guests, members and community. In The Saddle Providing technical support to users across MRC’s racecourse and venues both in person and remotely Installing, configuring and supporting Windows and Mac devices, POS systems, printers, phones and other IT technology Supporting and administering Microsoft 365 services including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange and Intune Troubleshooting hardware, software, network and connectivity issues Supporting POS and event technology across MRC’s venues and racecourses, including raceday and event support Managing user accounts, onboarding activities, device deployments and access through Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID Assisting with technology projects, system upgrades, hardware refreshes and continuous improvement initiatives Your Track Record A relevant IT qualification or equivalent hands-on experience in a Service Desk, Desktop Support or IT Support role Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and workplace technology environments Knowledge of Windows and Mac operating systems, device deployment and endpoint management practices Experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, user provisioning and access management Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot and modern device management concepts A sound understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, DHCP, VPNs and troubleshooting methodologies Strong problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to resolving technical issues Experience supporting POS, AV, hospitality or event technology environments will be advantageous Drivers Licence required The Perks Ongoing learning and development opportunities. Access to our year-round well-being initiatives including our Employee Assistance Program for staff and family. Racing Industry Member passes, discounts across our family of brands and free tickets to a wide range of events to enjoy with friends & family. Free onsite parking or a short walk from Caulfield train station. Leave options that suit your lifestyle, including paid parental leave, volunteer leave and cultural leave. Melbourne Racing Club values differences in gender, age, ethnicity, race, cultural background, disability, religion, and sexual orientation and encourages all suitable applicants to apply for this role. To apply online, please click on the appropriate link below.
